app.name: Health24
app.tagline: Your health record from every Health24 hospital
app.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the mobile number your hospital activated for you. We will send you a 6-digit code.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{phone}}, if it has access. It expires in 5 minutes.
signIn.resendIn_one: Send a new code in {{count}} second
signIn.resendIn_other: Send a new code in {{count}} seconds
signIn.noAccess: No access yet? Ask at the front desk of a hospital where you are registered. They will check who you are and turn it on.
signIn.chooseIntro: This phone can open more than one record. Choose one — you can switch later.

shell.actingForChild: Acting for {{name}}, as their guardian, until they turn 18

home.results: Test results outside the lab’s range
home.noResults: No recent results outside the range.
home.notAdvice: This is your record as your doctors wrote it. It is not medical advice — ask your doctor about anything here.
home.emergencyLine: {{hospital}} opened your record in an emergency on {{date}}.

timeline.title: Your health history
timeline.intro: Everything recorded about you at your Health24 hospitals, newest first.
timeline.openResults: See it in your test results

medicines.title: Your medicines
medicines.intro: Every medicine prescribed to you, newest first. One marked stopped or completed is no longer being taken.

problems.title: Your health problems
problems.intro: Diagnoses as your doctors recorded them, newest first.

allergies.title: Your allergies
allergies.intro: Allergies recorded at your hospitals. Tell every doctor who treats you about them.

reports.title: Your reports
reports.intro: Reports and bills from your hospitals. Opening one makes a link that works for about a minute.

results.title: Your test results
results.intro: Lab values typed from your reports. Choose a test to see how it has changed.
results.empty: No test results have been recorded.
results.noRange: No range printed on the report

trend.chartLabel: {{test}} over time. Every value is listed below the chart.

consents.title: Sharing your record
consents.intro: Each hospital sees what it recorded about you. You can let a hospital where you are registered also see your records from your other Health24 hospitals — only what you choose, for as long as you choose. You can stop at any time, and it takes effect at once.
consents.oneHospital: You are registered at one Health24 hospital, so there is nothing from other hospitals to share yet.
consents.start: Share my records with a hospital
consents.preview: {{hospital}} will see your {{records}} from your other Health24 hospitals until {{date}}.
consents.chooseCategories: Choose at least one kind of record.
consents.granted: {{hospital}} can now see what you chose.
consents.revoked: {{hospital}} can no longer see your records from other hospitals.
consents.noneActive: You are not sharing your record with any hospital.
consents.emergencyNote: Emergency access ends on its own within hours, and the hospital reviews whether it was needed.
consents.recordedAtDesk: Recorded at the hospital by {{name}} on {{date}}
consents.revokeConfirm: Stop sharing with {{hospital}}? It will no longer see these records from your other hospitals. What it recorded itself stays with it.

access.title: Who saw my record
access.intro: Everyone at a Health24 hospital who looked at or changed your record, what they saw, and why they could. Your own use of this portal is not listed.
access.empty: Nobody has looked at your record yet.
access.reviewPending: The hospital has not yet reviewed whether it was needed.
access.review_justified: The hospital reviewed it and found it was needed.
access.review_unjustified: The hospital reviewed it and found it was not needed.
access.toldBySms: We sent you a text message about it on {{date}}.
access.did_both: Looked at, added to or changed {{what}}
access.yourConsent: Allowed by the sharing you set up on {{date}}
access.deskConsent: Allowed by consent recorded at a hospital on {{date}}
access.ownRecords: Records this hospital holds about you

emergencyCard.title: Your emergency card
emergencyCard.intro: A card for your wallet and an image for your phone’s lock screen, so whoever treats you in an emergency knows what matters. You choose what it shows. Its QR code opens a page with the same details, kept up to date, without signing in.
emergencyCard.alwaysShown: Your name and age are always on it, so the card can be matched to you.
emergencyCard.noContact: No emergency contact is registered. Ask at your hospital’s front desk to add one.
emergencyCard.chooseOne: Choose at least one thing for the card.
emergencyCard.created: Your emergency card is ready. Print it, and save the image for your lock screen.
emergencyCard.howItWorks: Anyone who scans the code sees what the card shows, as it stands today, and every scan appears in “Who saw my record”. If you lose the card, replace it: the old code stops working.
emergencyCard.lockFooter: Scan the code for current details.
emergencyCard.saved: Your card now shows what you chose. The code is unchanged, so a printed card keeps working.
emergencyCard.replaceConfirm: Replace your card? The code on your old card and lock-screen image stops working at once. Print the new card and save a new image.
emergencyCard.replaced: Your new card is ready. The old code no longer works.
emergencyCard.revokeConfirm: Turn off your emergency card? Its code stops working at once. You can make a new card later.
emergencyCard.revoked: Your emergency card is turned off.

emergencyPage.title: Emergency medical information
emergencyPage.notInUse: This emergency card is not in use. It may have been replaced or turned off.
emergencyPage.slowDown: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
emergencyPage.note: Shared by the patient through Health24, as their hospitals recorded it. Confirm with the patient or their contact when you can.

myData.title: My data
myData.intro: Your rights over the information Health24 holds about you.
myData.exportIntro: We prepare your whole record in two files: one to read and print, and one in the FHIR format another hospital’s system can read. Preparing it takes a few minutes.
myData.ask: Prepare a copy of my record
myData.preparing: Your copy is being prepared. This page updates by itself.
myData.failed: Something went wrong preparing this copy. Ask for another.
myData.expired: The files were removed. Ask for a new copy whenever you need one.
myData.note: Downloading a copy is recorded in “Who saw my record”. Files are removed a week after they are ready, so a copy of your whole record is not left lying around.

corrections.title: Ask for a correction
corrections.intro: If something about you is wrong — your name, date of birth, number — ask the hospital that holds it to correct it. Their records staff make the change, and you see what they did.
corrections.noHospital: You are not registered at a Health24 hospital yet.
corrections.sent: Your request has been sent to the hospital.

erasure.title: Erase my data
erasure.intro: You can ask Health24 to erase your data. A data-protection officer reviews every request and tells you what was erased and what had to be kept.
erasure.kept: Your medical records are kept for as long as the law requires — a hospital cannot delete what a doctor recorded about your care. What can be erased is your portal account and sign-ins, your emergency card, the sharing you have set up, and the contact details hospitals hold for reaching you.
erasure.ask: Ask for my data to be erased
erasure.waiting: Your request is with the data-protection officer. You will see the decision here.
erasure.outcome_erased: Everything that could be erased was erased.
erasure.outcome_partly_erased: Some of it was erased; some had to be kept.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.intro: Sign out of any device you do not recognise or no longer use.
devices.none: No other devices are signed in.
